test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The first five year plan's main emphasis was to improve the condition of agriculture in India. It began in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The primary goal of the first Five-Year Plan **was to improve India's agricultural situation. The plan was started in 1951.
 
• Following independence, **India's First Five-Year Plan (FYP)** was launched in 1951, under the socialist influence of Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• Agriculture, price stability, power, and transportation were all part of the plan. The Harrod-Domar Model was used to create it.
 
• The process began with the establishment of the Planning Commission in March 1950, in order to achieve the government's stated goals of promoting a rapid rise in the people's standard of living through efficient exploitation of the country's resources, increased production, and providing opportunities for all to work in the community's service.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan was started in 1951, and two more five-year plans were developed until 1965 when the Indo-Pakistan conflict forced a pause. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans (FYPs) **are national economic programs that are controlled and integrated.
 
• In 1928, Joseph Stalin implemented the Soviet Union's first Five-Year Plan. They have since been adopted by the majority of communist regimes as well as a number of capitalist countries.
 
• The Indian economy was built on the concept of planning from 1947 to 2017.
 
• This was carried out through the Planning Commission (1951-2014) and the NITI Aayog's Five-Year Plans, which were established, implemented, and monitored (2015-2017).
